metadata.name: reset-sessions-best-effort
metadata.description: Best-effort deletion of existing sessions for deterministic terminal tests

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const maxAttempts = 8; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); let remainingCount = -1; for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) { try { const listRes = await fetch('/api/v1/sessions', { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!listRes.ok) { await sleep(250); continue; } const sessions = await listRes.json(); if (!Array.isArray(sessions)) { await sleep(250); continue; } if (sessions.length > 0) { for (const session of sessions) { const id = session && typeof session.id === 'string' ? session.id : ''; if (!id) continue; try { await fetch(`/api/v1/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); } catch {} } } await sleep(250); const verifyRes = await fetch('/api/v1/sessions', { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!verifyRes.ok) { await sleep(250); continue; } const remaining = await verifyRes.json(); if (Array.isArray(remaining)) { remainingCount = remaining.length; if (remainingCount === 0) break; } } catch {} await sleep(250); } document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-session-reset-count', String(Math.max(remainingCount, 0))); document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-session-reset-clean', remainingCount === 0 ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

metadata.label: Best-effort reset of existing terminal sessions
